verdict.rationale: Navan supports natural-language operation via its MCP server (query spend/policy data, flagged expenses, card details) and via the Ava assistant (summarize spend, compare to policy) and Navan Edge chat for travel changes with explicit confirmation before booking. This covers querying, analysis, and even action-taking (with confirmation) through natural language across multiple product surfaces. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of NL command reliability and broader action coverage beyond travel/expense queries.
